openai.feedback:
- Category: spec
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/components/external/mission/MissionActivityFeedCard.tsx:148
- Finding: Failed test output still renders directly in the feed through `card.detail`. The resolver continues attaching error excerpts to test cards, and the updated tests explicitly preserve this behavior. This only removes generic command errors; it does not satisfy “No error messages in the chat at all.”
- Suggestion: Stop attaching or displaying failed tool output in feed cards, including test failures. Keep genuine interactive questions and any required test verdict indicators separate from terminal error text.

- Category: test
- Severity: low
- File: client/src/components/external/mission/MissionActivityFeedCard.test.tsx:196
- Finding: The new “compact (non-oversized)” test only checks that an SVG exists. It would pass if the sizing rule were removed entirely, reproducing the oversized checkmark this change is meant to fix.
- Suggestion: Add a browser assertion that checks the rendered glyph dimensions against the link’s line size.

Overall assessment: ship-with-fixes. The generic blocker removal is implemented, but terminal error output still appears in the feed contrary to the explicit scope.

glm.feedback:
- Category: spec
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/lib/missionActivityFeedResolve.ts (~line 207, the `else if (result.is_error) { ... continue; }` branch)
- Finding: The spec says "Verify the same logic does not also drive genuine interactive blockers or questions and keep those." The removed `handleGenericBlockerError` was the generic catch-all for every `is_error` tool_result outside the test/subrunner/review branches. This diff replaces it with an unconditional `continue` and contains no test or code demonstrating that an interactive blocker path (e.g. a permission prompt / AskUserQuestion-style interruption surfacing through an error tool_result) is still surfaced. If any genuine interactive blocker previously reached this branch, it is now silently dropped.
- Suggestion: Add a test seeding an interactive-blocker-shaped error result and assert a card still renders; if it doesn't, restore a narrow branch for that case before the `continue`.

- Category: spec
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/components/external/mission/MissionActivityFeedCard.tsx / mission-operation.css
- Finding: The spec's subrunner requirement is "the report shows a readable title with a link, not just a hash." The diff contains only a CSS size fix and a new test; no renderer change converts a hash-only subrunner title into the dispatch title/link. If the readable title already existed, this is fine, but if the shipped card showed a hash (as the spec implies), that half of the subrunner work is missing — the new test only checks that `card.text` renders and that an svg exists, which would pass against the old hash-only rendering too as long as text is passed through.
- Suggestion: Verify against the mockup (board 2) what the subrunner row should show, and either add a renderer change or pin in the test that the rendered label is the dispatch title, not the agent id/hash.

- Category: test
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/lib/missionActivityFeed.test.ts ("a failed read never produces an error card") and missionActivityFeedFields.test.ts ("attaches no error excerpt for a single failing non-test command")
- Finding: These tests assert only negative invariants (`status !== "err"`, `detail === undefined`) which pass trivially if the reducer produces zero cards or drops them entirely — including a wrong implementation that also drops the turn's narration card. The fields test even acknowledges the card is dropped ("a wordless read-only card is dropped"). Nothing pins that the turn's own narration card still survives with its text, unlike the (g) test in missionActivityFeed.explanation.test.ts which does it properly.
- Suggestion: In the single-failing-command cases, also assert the surviving card's text/explanation (like the (g) test does) so the "keep the turn's narration" behavior is pinned at every mutation site.

- Category: edge-case
- Severity: low
- File: client/src/lib/missionActivityFeedResolve.ts (the `continue` branch)
- Finding: A failed command's card now keeps only whatever the turn wrote plus a bare command chip with no status marker — a card reading "Pushing the branch." + a `Bash: git push` chip is visually identical whether the push failed or succeeded. This is presumably the accepted M1 trade-off, but there is no test pinning that a *successful* and a *failed* command render distinguishably (or intentionally not), so a future change could reintroduce or over-remove status silently.
- Suggestion: Add one test asserting the intended final shape for a failed command's card (text kept, no err pill) next to the successful twin.

- Category: regression
- Severity: low
- File: client/src/lib/missionActivityFeedTypes.ts — removal of `ActivityKind` "blocker" and `textLiteral`, plus deletion of `summarizeBlockerError`'s re-export in missionActivityFeedText.ts
- Finding: These are hard removals of exported surface. Everything visible in the diff compiles, but any consumer outside the diff (other components, e2e helpers, or snapshot fixtures referencing `kind: "blocker"` / `textLiteral` / `summarizeBlockerError`) will now break at type-check or runtime. The e2e file updated here suggests there may be more stale references elsewhere in the e2e suite.
- Suggestion: Run a repo-wide grep for `"blocker"`, `textLiteral`, and `summarizeBlockerError` before merging; update or remove any remaining fixtures.

Overall: the core M1 removal is implemented coherently and the deletion of the blocker machinery is thorough, but the spec's explicit "verify interactive blockers survive" requirement is not evidenced, and the subrunner "readable title" half may be missing. Ship-with-fixes.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
